C0454.title: Bank Card Stolen and Drained — Gaochang Police Crack the Case, Recover Assets, and Return ¥34,000 in Losses
C0454.summary: In June 2024, a resident surnamed Ka in Gaochang District, Xinjiang, reported that ¥34,000 had been stolen from his bank account. Investigation revealed that suspect Ai had repeatedly transferred funds from Ka's account to unfamiliar accounts between May and June 2024 via Tenpay-QQ transfers and QQ red packets. Police arrested Ai on July 2, recovering and returning all losses to the victim.
